title: The homepage gets a text feed
summary:
A text feed joined the homepage, Llama 4 Scout joined the model lineup, and link previews stopped depending on JavaScript.

The homepage now has a toggle between image and text feeds. The new text feed includes a stream of generated responses and an editor; projects now open on a Featured category with tabs for browsing.

Added `llamascout` through Cloudflare with a 4096-token output limit. The `mistral` and `qwen-qwq` mappings now use Cloudflare models, while the `deepseek-reasoning` listing points to DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B rather than full DeepSeek R1.

Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata moved into the initial HTML, letting link previews read the site title, description, and banner without running React.

highlights.title: A feed for text
highlights.text: Switch between image and text feeds on the homepage, and use the editor alongside a stream of generated responses. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Llama 4 Scout added
highlights.text: Use `llamascout` for text generation, with a 4096-token output limit. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llamascout).
